news.title: RATEGAIN: New AI And Payments Push Will Likely Leave Shares Overpriced
news.body: Analysts have kept the price target for RateGain Travel Technologies steady at ₹520, citing only minor adjustments to assumptions on discount rate, revenue growth, profit margins, and future P/E that largely offset one another. What's in the News RateGain launched RG Pay, a unified payments platform for travel and hospitality that combines localized payment acceptance, affordability options such as BNPL and EMI, virtual card management, and cross-border settlement within a single infrastructure.

news.title: RATEGAIN: AI Travel Data Platform Will Drive Future Upside Potential
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for RateGain Travel Technologies steady at ₹875.0. The unchanged price target reflects offsetting tweaks to assumptions, including a slightly higher discount rate, more measured revenue growth expectations, a modestly stronger profit margin outlook, and a higher future P/E multiple. What's in the News RateGain launched RG Pay, a unified payments infrastructure aimed at improving revenue realization, payment flexibility, and cross-border settlement for hotels, OTAs, and travel partners across global markets.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.24 (down from ₹4.80 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹5.57b (up 100% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹264.5m (down 53% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 4.8% (down from 20% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.2%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 45%. Revenue is forecast to grow 30% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Software industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 34% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 14% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: RateGain Travel Technologies Limited Announces the Appointment of Ashu Sharma as Senior Vice President, People & Culture
news.body: RateGain Travel Technologies Limited announced the appointment of Ashu Sharma as Senior Vice President, People & Culture . The newly appointed leader, reporting to the Chief Human Resources Officer: Ashu Sharma, an accomplished HR leader with experience at Adobe and Vodafone, will oversee Corporate HR, People Business Partnering across APMEA (including the corporate office), and Workplace Experience, bringing greater consistency, governance, and scale to RateGain's people practices.

news.title: Price target increased by 9.4% to ₹740
news.body: Up from ₹676, the current price target is an average from 8 analysts. New target price is approximately in line with last closing price of ₹714. Stock is up 4.4% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹17.14 for next year compared to ₹17.73 last year.

news.title: Consensus revenue estimates increase by 15%
news.body: The consensus outlook for fiscal year 2026 has been updated. 2026 revenue forecast increased from ₹15.5b to ₹17.8b. EPS estimate unchanged at ₹17.14. Net income forecast to grow 9.9% next year vs 16% growth forecast for Software industry in India. Consensus price target up from ₹676 to ₹712. Share price rose 8.3% to ₹714 over the past week.
